headlines.title: 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟
headlines.summary: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟。王毅说，在两国元首领航掌舵下，双方正在推动构建中美建设性战略稳定关系。事实证明，改善发展中美关系，在相互尊重基础上和平共处，进而合作共赢，符合两国人民根本利益，符合国际社会共同期待。同时，中美关系仍面临各种风险挑战。双方应把两国元首达成的重要共识落到实处，聚焦积极议程，妥善管控分歧，为两国高层交往排除干扰、克服障碍，推动中美关系朝着稳定、健康、可持续的方向发展。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi Meets US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
headlines.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns in Beijing. Wang said that under the stewardship of the two heads of state, both sides are working to build a constructive strategic and stable relationship between China and the US. Facts have proven that improving and developing China-US relations, coexisting peacefully on the basis of mutual respect, and then pursuing win-win cooperation, serves the fundamental interests of both peoples and meets the common expectations of the international community. At the same time, China-US relations still face various risks and challenges. Both sides should implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, focus on a positive agenda, properly manage differences, remove interference and overcome obstacles for high-level exchanges, and promote the stable, healthy and sustainable development of China-US relations.

headlines.title: 华福证券管涛：外部流动性影响A股需“精准拆解”
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月27日讯，8月26日，华福证券召开2026年秋季经济与投资策略会，华福证券首席经济学家表示，去年美联储降息三次，今年以来按兵不动，但市场预期频繁反复，导致金融条件总体宽松但波动显著放大。但外部流动性影响需区分具体驱动源，并置于不同前提下分析，不可简单归因。这种预期波动主要通过两条路径影响A股：一是资本流动渠道，紧缩预期升温会推动美元走强，引发新兴市场资本外流压力，导致汇率与资产价格承压；二是市场情绪与信心渠道，美股作为全球风险资产风向标，其波动具有强外溢性——例如若紧缩预期引发美国科技股调整，极可能带动全球科技板块共振下行。

headlines.title_en: Huafu Securities Guan Tao: External liquidity impact on A-shares requires 'precise analysis'
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data Aug 27: On Aug 26, Huafu Securities held its 2026 Autumn Economic and Investment Strategy Conference. Huafu Securities' chief economist said the Fed cut rates three times last year and has stayed on hold this year, but market expectations have frequently reversed, leaving financial conditions broadly loose yet highly volatile. External liquidity effects must be analyzed by specific drivers and under different premises, not simply attributed. Such expectation swings affect A-shares through two channels: first, capital flows—tightening expectations push the dollar higher, causing emerging market capital outflows and pressuring currencies and asset prices; second, market sentiment and confidence—US stocks as the global risk-asset bellwether have strong spillover effects; for example, if tightening expectations trigger a US tech correction, it could easily drag global tech sectors down in tandem.

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association: New residential home sales in July up over 30% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association released its July 2026 Shenzhen property market summary. According to Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform data, July 2026 saw 4,502 new commercial housing units sold citywide, down 35.2% MoM but up 19.3% YoY; of these, 3,529 were residential units, down 6.8% MoM and up 32.5% YoY. The MoM decline in new commercial housing in July reflects normal seasonal fluctuation; residential sales fell only slightly MoM while rising over 30% YoY, indicating that genuine purchasing power in the new-home market remains ample, supported by favorable policies such as easing purchase restrictions in core districts.

headlines.title_en: August 27 midday market review: STAR 50 Index up 3.45% in morning session, computing hardware and chip stocks rally

PCB, CPO and other computing hardware stocks strengthened; Jin'an Guoji, Baoding Technology, Tiantong Co. and others hit limit up. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied; Siwei Electronics, Ambiq Micro, Dapu Micro all hit 20cm limit up. Agriculture stocks traded actively; Xinsai Co., Xinnong Development, Wanxiang Denong and others hit limit up. On the downside, solar equipment sector fell; Sungrow Power dropped over 10%. Gainers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,000 stocks up across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges; morning turnover reached 1.36 trillion yuan. At midday close: Shanghai Composite +0.6%, Shenzhen Component +1.19%, ChiNext +1.51%. 2. Leading sectors: computing hardware, semiconductor chips, agriculture, consumer electronics; lagging sectors: banks, baijiu, steel, solar equipment. 3. Total 2,874 stocks up across both exchanges.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Rating and Valuation Department: July residential property price index down 0.46% month-on-month, ending 13-month uptrend
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data Aug 27: Hong Kong Rating and Valuation Department data shows the July private residential property price index stood at 321.5, down 0.46% MoM, ending a 13-month uptrend, but up 11.6% YoY. Prices rose 7.3% in the first seven months of the year. The July rental index was 207.4, up 0.8% MoM and 5.07% YoY, hitting a fresh record high. The rental index rose 3.44% in the first seven months. Cushman & Wakefield Deputy Managing Director and Head of Research Hong Kong, Aline Tang, said the new Fed chair's recent inauguration adds uncertainty to the future rate path, with the market awaiting policy direction and its impact on rates. Combined with geopolitical tensions and global financial market volatility, some buyers may adopt a cautious wait-and-see stance in the near term. However, Hong Kong's housing demand and population inflows continue to support the residential market.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：1-7月规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%
headlines.summary: 1—7月份，制造业向产业链、价值链中高端转型持续推进，规模以上高技术制造业利润同比增长50.1%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长9.6个百分点。从行业看，电子及通信设备制造领域中，光纤制造、光缆制造、通信系统设备制造行业利润分别增长468.4%、62.6%、55.0%；医疗仪器设备及仪器仪表制造领域中，导航、测绘、气象及海洋专用仪器制造行业利润增长157.8%，口腔科用设备及器具制造行业利润增长74.5%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: January-July profits of large-scale high-tech manufacturing up 50.1% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: In the first seven months of the year, manufacturing continued upgrading toward the mid-to-high end of the industrial and value chains. Profits of large-scale high-tech manufacturing grew 50.1% YoY, contributing 9.6 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth. By industry, within electronics and communications equipment manufacturing, optical fiber, optical cable and communications system equipment manufacturing saw profit growth of 468.4%, 62.6% and 55.0% respectively; within medical instruments and equipment manufacturing, navigation, surveying, meteorological and marine special instrument manufacturing profits rose 157.8%, and dental equipment and appliance manufacturing profits rose 74.5%.

The semiconductor sector continued to climb, with Saiwei Microelectronics, Xiandao Jidian, Angrui Micro, and Dapu Micro hitting daily limit ups. headlines.title: 知情人士回应“A股未盈利企业无法上市”
headlines.summary: 近日，有市场传言称，A股未盈利企业IPO申报全面收紧，港股同步受到影响。从知情人士处了解到，目前不存在未盈利企业一律无法上市的可能性，无论A股还是港股，都会继续向优质未盈利企业敞开大门，只是对未盈利企业的审核更为严格，要求企业具备更为明确的商业变现路径与业绩改善预期；对于亏损持续未见收窄、短期商业化落地难度较大，且并非细分行业绝对头部的企业，IPO审核尺度将更为严苛。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: Insiders respond to 'unprofitable companies unable to list on A-shares'
headlines.summary_en: Recently, market rumors suggested A-share IPO applications from unprofitable companies have been comprehensively tightened, with Hong Kong similarly affected. Sources familiar with the matter indicate there is currently no situation where all unprofitable companies are barred from listing. Both A-shares and Hong Kong will continue to open doors to quality unprofitable companies, but review standards for such firms have become stricter, requiring clearer commercialization paths and earnings improvement expectations. For companies with persistently widening losses, difficult near-term commercialization, and which are not absolute leaders in their niche, IPO review standards will be more stringent. (21财经)

headlines.title_en: Insiders respond to 'unprofitable companies unable to list on A-shares': not a block, just quality improvement
headlines.summary_en: Recently, market rumors have suggested a comprehensive tightening of IPO applications for unprofitable companies in A-shares, with Hong Kong stocks also affected. A reporter learned from informed sources that there is currently no possibility of unprofitable companies being completely barred from listing. Both A-shares and Hong Kong will continue to open their doors to quality unprofitable companies, but the review process will be stricter, requiring companies to have clearer commercial monetization paths and performance improvement expectations. For companies with persistent losses that have not narrowed, difficulty in short-term commercialization, and are not absolute leaders in their niche sectors, IPO review standards will be more stringent. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平。 未来通胀走向面临较高不确定性，主要与油价、汇率、内需复苏节奏以及工资上涨扩散程度相关。 将继续实施能将CPI通胀率稳定在目标水平的货币政策。 在出口和投资保持高增长的推动下，预计国内经济将继续维持强劲增长。 消费复苏步伐将逐渐加快。 将评估通胀、国内经济以及金融稳定状况。 需要密切关注居民债务增长情况。 芯片领域的扩张程度、中东局势发展以及贸易环境的变化仍存在不确定性。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation expected to remain above target for a considerable period
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation expected to remain above target for a considerable period. Inflation outlook faces high uncertainty, mainly related to oil prices, exchange rates, the pace of domestic demand recovery, and the spread of wage increases. Will continue to implement monetary policy that keeps CPI inflation stable at target. Domestic economy expected to maintain strong growth, driven by robust export and investment growth. Consumption recovery pace will gradually accelerate. Will assess inflation, domestic economy and financial stability conditions. Needs to closely monitor household debt growth. Uncertainty remains over the extent of chip sector expansion, Middle East developments and changes in the trade environment.

headlines.title_en: August 27 midday news selection
headlines.summary_en: [Midday News Selection for August 27] 1. By midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.60%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.19%, the ChiNext Index rose 1.51%, and the STAR 50 Index rose 3.45%. 2. At the midday close of Hong Kong stocks, the Hang Seng Index fell 0.42%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.19%. 3. Data from the National Bureau of Statistics shows that from January to July, industrial enterprises above designated size achieved a total profit of 4,582.06 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 17.6%. 4. Youdao launched its first Agent headphones for iPhone users, with pre-sales starting today. 5. The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate from 2.75% to 3.00%, marking a second consecutive rate hike, in line with market expectations.

headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计2026年GDP增长率为3.3%，此前预测为2.6%
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计2026年GDP增长率为3.3%，此前预测为2.6%。 预计2027年GDP增长率为2.9%，此前预测为2.1%。 预计2026年CPI上涨2.7%，与5月份的预测一致。 预计2027年CPI上涨2.3%，与5月份的预测一致。
